newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges rates for bids, offers flat to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges rates for bids, offers flat to higher.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady to higher for bids and offers on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded Monday versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, this week, Illinois River, bid 210 percent, up 10 percentage points, similar, offered 220 percent, up 10 percentage points, similar.
- Two barges, this week, Lower Ohio River, bid 195 percent, up 15 percentage points, similar.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, bid 215 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, week of Oct 27, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), bid 175 percent, offered 190 percent.
- Four barges, two each week of Oct 20 and 27, Illinois River, bid 215 percent, offered 230 percent.
- Four barges, two each week of Oct 20 and 27, Lower Ohio River, bid 200 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, two each week of Oct 20 and 27, Mid-Mississippi, no bid, offered 235 percent.
